messages:
jess_support: FYI — seeing a bunch of p95/p99 latency complaints from multiple customers starting ~10:45 UTC during the billing window. dashboards -> https://dash.redwood.internal/r/latency spike shows scale-up queueing + attach times around 12-18s :grimacing:
max_infra: Which pools are affected? Dedicated priority pools or shared hotpools? Any 5xx errors in the API?
jess_support: Mostly dedicated pools for priority customers (tags: priority, acme). Example from ACME: repeated requests hit scaleup, then long attach. Repro quick curl below (times in ms):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "X-Customer: acme" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/generate -w '\ntime_total:%{time_total}\n' -o /dev/null
# observed: time_total:13.2  (spike case)
```
Also some requests returned 503 with message: "capacity temporarily unavailable" but mostly just high p99.
olga_sre: Looking at infra metrics — autoscaler queue length spikes correlated with image-pull and warmup timeouts. attach_success_latency_p99 ~ 16s for those pools, attach_error_rate up x4. Likely a combo: (a) Dedicated pool saturation (no spare GPUs), (b) recent image rollout causing slower image pulls, (c) warmup tasks not finishing before attach.
raj_platform: For immediate mitigation we can: (1) bump min_pool for affected priority pools (2) enable proactive warmup for recently used model images (3) temporarily route some traffic to a smaller/quantized model variant as fallback. I can run pool update commands if SRE ok. Example command to bump:
```
rbctl pools update --pool priority-eu-1 --min-instances 3 --proactive-warmup enabled
```
jess_support: @raj_platform please do the min_pool bump for acme-afflicted pools. Also posting a short customer workaround to share with support: advise retry/backoff (exponential) and temporarily switch to model: gpt-small-q4 for non-critical queries.
max_infra: I'll collect attach logs and image-pull metrics. Steps I'm running: `kubectl logs -l app=pool-manager --since=2h | grep attach` plus `aws ecr get-download-metrics` for the timeframe. If image-pull is the tail, we need to roll back the image rollout or stagger it.
alan_customer: Thanks — our traffic pattern surged during the invoice batch at 10:42. Can you confirm the mitigation so we can resume normal ops?
deploy_bot: Deploy finished: pool-manager v1.4.3 -> v1.4.4 at 4470001270 by raj_platform :white_check_mark:
olga_sre: Mitigation update: bumped min_instances on priority-eu-1 and priority-us-2, enabled proactive-warmup for last-used images. Also added a temporary admission control rule to limit new non-priority attaches to 5r/s to reduce thundering herd. Early metric check: attach_latency_p99 down from ~16s to ~6.5s over the last 15m.
jess_support: Sharing the quick playbook we used so support can respond: 1) Confirm customer tag and drift time window. 2) Advise retry/backoff + fallback model. 3) Escalate to infra/SRE for min_pool bump and proactive warmup. 4) If image rollout in last 30m, consider rollback/stagger.
max_infra: Action items for follow-up: collect full `pool_manager` logs (done), extract image-pull timings, correlate with ECR throttling metrics, and ensure next deploy uses randomized rollout to avoid simultaneous cold pulls. Filed ticket INFRA-872.
olga_sre: I'll open an incident ticket and schedule a short post-incident review if we see recurrence. For now closing the customer escalations loop — please reopen if any customer still seeing >2s p99 regression. :thumbsup:
jess_support: Thanks team — passing update back to affected customers (ACME, NovaLabs). Closing thread unless new reports come in.
